verdict.rationale: xAI documents hands-free voice conversations directly in Grok ('Talk to Grok hands-free with voice') and separately documents real-time streaming speech-to-text with VAD tuning, indicating a live voice-conversation feature exists. However, missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of voice conversation naturalness or latency, and no detail on turn-taking/interruption handling beyond the VAD parameter.
